Freedos, the God of Peace, claims to have the royal dragon\ncocoon. Skeptical, you decide to check it with Kunon.\nHead to Vanek Plains where you promised to meet!
In Vanek Plains, the ark is being attacked by bandits with\na cannon! They are shooting from Afval Uplands!\nGo stop them before the ark crashes!
You quickly climb to the top of Afval Uplands and see the\nbandits shooting the ark. Hurry and stop them now!
Cannon Master Bakuzan, the bandit boss who controls a huge\ncannon, is repeatedly commanding his lackeys to shoot the\nark! There's no time! Defeat Cannon Master Bakuzan now!
